error_definition: error_two_party = poll_margin_two_party - result_margin_two_party, in percentage points. Positive means the poll's two-candidate margin was more Democratic than the official two-candidate margin.
margin_definition: poll_margin_two_party and result_margin_two_party are both (Democratic share - Republican share) / (Democratic share + Republican share) * 100 for the same two candidates. Other candidates, undecided responses, and blank ballots are outside that denominator. margin_dem_minus_rep, the unrescaled published poll gap, is retained and is not the primary error.
inclusion_rules: FiveThirtyEight historical Senate questions only. 2026 polls have no result and are not scored.
Exactly one Democratic-side share (DEM or DFL) and one Republican share.
Not hypothetical, not a ranked-choice reallocation, and a general or runoff stage.
Fieldwork end date on or before the poll's election date. A missing election date is not filled in.
Both candidate names match one official contest of the same state, stage, and election year.
Two official contests with the same names, such as a same-day special and full-term ballot, are excluded.
leakage_controls: Result votes are not used to choose which candidate or which contest a poll matches.
Polls that ended after election day are excluded before a result margin is attached.
Race averages are computed from poll margins and sample sizes only, then the result is subtracted.
Result fields are written only to the analysis outputs, not back onto the cleaned poll tables.
